fields.label: Repo URL
fields.help: The branch name to use for deployments.

fields.label: Rollback Enabled
fields.help: Should the Deployment Rollback be enabled? Defaults to `false`

fields.label: Slot ID
fields.help: The ID of the Linux or Windows Web App Slot.

fields.label: Use Local Git
fields.help: Should the Slot use local Git configuration.

fields.label: Generate Workflow File
fields.help: Should the service generate the GitHub Action Workflow file.

fields.label: Runtime Stack
fields.help: The value to use for the Runtime Stack in the workflow file content for code base apps.

fields.label: Runtime Version
fields.help: The value to use for the Runtime Version in the workflow file content for code base apps.

fields.label: Image Name
fields.help: The image name for the build.

fields.label: Registry Password
fields.help: The password used to upload the image to the container registry.

fields.label: Registry URL
fields.help: The server URL for the container registry where the build will be hosted.

fields.label: Registry Username
fields.help: The username used to upload the image to the container registry.
